entries.wording: The electronic information of the goods has been received
entries.note: The order's data received, while the shipment's status is ToPickuped (Awaiting Pickup, 待揽收).
The order's data received, sent with no node: the first scan, before the collection.
The parcel collected from the shop, before the sorting centre's inbound scan.
The sorting centre's inbound scan, after the collection.
The departure from the origin, after the sorting centre.
The line's receipt of the parcel, after its departure from the origin.
The line's origin hub, a minute after its receipt.
The line weighing the parcel at its origin hub.
The line sending the parcel on from its origin hub.
The export clearance, after the line sends the parcel on from its origin hub.
The parcel at the delivery point, filed under the departure node: still on the way, no delivery run yet.
The line's notice of a new expected delivery date, at the second of its record of the shipper's data: it moves nothing and keeps the stage of the scan before it.
The line's record of the shipper's data, written after the sorting centre's scans: it moves nothing and keeps the stage of the scan before it.
